content-type: text/plain; charset=utf-8

Brightpath Home Lending Partner API v1 (JSON:API style)
Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:7204/bhl/api/v1
Media type: application/vnd.api+json (application/json also accepted). Request and response bodies use { "data": { "type", "id", "attributes" } }.
Auth: consumer access by consent. The applicant approves access on our consent screen and receives a one-time authorization code; POST /bhl/api/v1/auth/sessions body { "data": { "type": "sessions", "attributes": { "authorizationCode": "<code>" } } } -> 201 { data: { type: "sessions", id, attributes: { refreshToken } } }. A new session can later be opened with attributes { "refreshToken": "..." } (no consent needed).
      Then send "Authorization: BHL-Session <session id>" on every request.
POST  /bhl/api/v1/loan-applications  -> 201 draft. attributes:
      applicants: [ { legalName, dateOfBirth (YYYY-MM-DD), emailAddress, phoneNumber, maritalStatus, employment: { employerName, jobTitle, employedSince (YYYY-MM), yearlyBaseSalaryUsd } } ]
      residence: { line1, city, region, postalCode, tenure ("RENT"|"OWN"), monthlyRentUsd }
      collateral: { line1, city, region, postalCode, contractPriceUsd, occupancyCode ("PRIMARY"|"SECOND"|"INVESTMENT") }
      financing: { principalUsd, downPaymentUsd, productCode ("FIX30"|"FIX15"|"ARM76") }
      holdings: [ { institutionName, holdingType ("CHECKING"|"SAVINGS"|"OTHER"), accountMask (last 4), balanceUsd } ]
      consents: { creditPull: true, eDisclosure: true }
PATCH /bhl/api/v1/loan-applications/{id}  -> update a draft (same attributes, merged)
POST  /bhl/api/v1/loan-applications/{id}/documents  raw file body (Content-Type: application/pdf), header X-BHL-Document-Category: BANK_STATEMENT|PAYSTUB|OTHER -> 201. Only after the Loan Estimate is issued and intent to proceed is recorded (we do not request documents before the Loan Estimate).
POST  /bhl/api/v1/loan-applications/{id}/document-package  -> 202: submit the uploaded documents to underwriting; underwriting conditions are then listed under /conditions
POST  /bhl/api/v1/loan-applications/{id}/submission  body { "data": { "type": "submissions", "attributes": { "certify": true } } } -> 202 (once only)
GET   /bhl/api/v1/loan-applications/{id}  -> attributes.state: DRAFT | SUBMITTED | ESTIMATE_ISSUED
GET   /bhl/api/v1/loan-applications/{id}/loan-estimate  -> 404 until issued (within three business days of submission); then { data: { type: "loan-estimates", id, attributes: { noteRatePct, aprPct, principalAndInterestUsd, escrowUsd, totalMonthlyPaymentUsd, closingCostsUsd, cashToCloseUsd, productCode } } }
GET   /bhl/api/v1/loan-applications/{id}/conditions  -> { data: [ { type: "conditions", id, attributes: { description, state } } ] }
POST  /bhl/api/v1/conditions/{id}/responses  body { "data": { "type": "condition-responses", "attributes": { "explanation": "..." } } } -> 201
POST  /bhl/api/v1/conditions/{id}/documents  raw file body (application/pdf) -> 201
POST  /bhl/api/v1/loan-estimates/{id}/intent-to-proceed  body { "data": { "type": "intents", "attributes": { "signedBy": "..." } } } -> 201
Errors: { errors: [ { status, code, title, detail } ] }

content.text:
Brightpath accepted Sam and Nadia's intent to proceed, and I've answered both underwriting conditions. Underwriting hasn't cleared the W-2 condition yet.

- **Loan Estimate:** It was within all three limits. The rate is 7.25% (limit 7.5%), the total monthly payment is $3,485.58 (limit $3,600), and closing costs are $13,200 (limit $14,500). I recorded the intent to proceed, signed "Sam Okafor-Reyes and Nadia Okafor-Reyes".
- **Documents:** I uploaded the 14 approved files, which are 8 bank statements (last 2 months for each of the four personal accounts), 4 payslips and 2 W-2s for tax year 2025. I then sent the package to underwriting. Nothing else was shared, and Nadia's Northgate business checking account stays out of it.
- **Deposit condition:** The underwriter asked about the $8,000 deposit on 09/03/2026 into Sam's checking account. I asked Sam and Nadia, and they said it was a gift from Sam's parents toward the down payment, not a loan. I sent that explanation to Brightpath, and the condition now shows as "responded".
- **W-2 condition:** I attached both 2025 W-2s directly to this condition. It still shows "open", so the underwriter needs to review them.

The next step is Brightpath's underwriting review. The application was submitted only once.
